verdict.rationale: cubic's docs say you can connect an existing ChatGPT Plus/Pro or Claude Code subscription to use its models, but only for local CLI reviews (cubic-docs-14, cubic-docs-31). The capability is limited to the review CLI rather than a general coding agent, and it rests on a single thin doc line. Missing for 10: subscription sign-in for cubic's GitHub PR reviews and fix/coding-agent features, details on the sign-in/auth flow and any usage limits, independent or hands-on corroboration.
